name: reels
description: Faceless Indonesian reels generator — Remotion + Piper/ElevenLabs (TTS) + whisper.cpp (captions)

scripts.build:audio: npm run tts && npm run captions
scripts.build:audio:eleven: npm run tts:eleven && npm run captions
scripts.render: remotion render Reel out/reel.mp4 --browser-executable="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
scripts.all: npm run build:audio && npm run render
